name: How much does it cost to build a backyard ADU in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a backyard ADU in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a backyard ADU in Los Angeles varies significantly based on size, design complexity, materials, and site conditions. Expenses typically include design and architectural fees, permits, construction, and utility hookups. A general estimate might range from $150,000 to over $300,000. It's crucial to get a detailed quote tailored to your specific project and property.
